newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African wool prices hihger at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: S.African wool prices hihger at latest auction.

text.p: South African wool prices were higher at the latest weekly auction, the Wool Board said.
It said 13,636 bales were offered at this week's sale, of which 96.9 percent was sold.

Price quotes for long Merino fleeces of 20 micron rose 5.4 percent, 21 micron rose 7.5 percent, 22 micron rose 3.5 percent, 23 micron rose 1.1 percent, 24 micron fell 0.7 percent and 25 micron rose 0.5 percent.
Prices for Merino bellies rose 0.9 percent, Merino lambs rose 4.0 percent and Merino locks fell 1.1 percent.
The offering included 1,781 bales of other White Wools, 2,223 bales of Lesotho and 1,193 bales of coarse and coloured.

Of the 504 bales of 20 micron offered, 93.5 percent was sold. Of the 1,536 bales of 21 micron offered, 97.6 percent was sold. Of the 1,890 bales of 22 micron offered, 98.0 percent was sold. Of the 1,679 bales of 23 micron offered, 98.9 percent was sold and of 809 bales of 24 micron offered, 92.1 percent was sold. Of the 243 bales of 25 micron offered, 98.4 percent was sold.
The next sale will take place on May 7, when about 8,000 bales will be on offer.
